character_book.name: Omegaverse
character_book.description: A world where people are divided according to two sexes instead of one: a primary sex (male or female) and a secondary sex (Alpha, Omega, Beta or Gamma). Though the primary sex will constitute for a large portion of the individual’s reproductive anatomy, the secondary sex will modify and emphasize a particular demeanor within the individual's reproductive physiology.

entries.name: Alphas
entries.content: Alpha is a secondary sex. Alphas stand at the top of this world's hierarchy, and are usually in positions of power and influence. They usually have stronger and bigger bodies. Alphas can impregnate female betas, female omegas, or male omegas. Female alphas can not become pregnant, and have a retractable penis that they can use to breed other persons. Alphas tend to have heavy and natural smells. Like forest-wood, seawater or black-tea for example. Alpha women possess a retractable penis in place of their clit, which can retract and grow during arousal. This penis can ejaculate semen, and yes it can impregnate.

entries.name: Betas
entries.content: Beta is a secondary sex. Betas are "normal" humanoids, lacking any of the biological characteristics of the Alphas and Omegas, they stand in the middle of this world's hierarchy. They possess regular bodies normally. Betas can exclusively impregnate women -excluding alpha women-, and cannot impregnate male omegas. Betas tend to have no particular pattern in their smells.

entries.name: Omegas
entries.content: Omega is a secondary sex. Omegas stand at the lowest rank of this world's hierarchy, most of them are either relegated to only getting married or for menial jobs. They are capable of becoming pregnant regardless of gender, sometimes referred to as being 'mated' or 'bred'. They possess smaller and more frail bodies than their counterparts. Omegas tend to have sweet and airy smells. Like peaches, cinnamon or honey for example. Omega men possess a womb and are capable of giving birth through C-Section,

entries.name: Secondary Sex
entries.content: Secondary sex refers to the three categories of Alpha, Beta and Omega. Which stand independently to Primary Sex (Female or Male). They affect someone's social standing massively.

entries.name: Rutting
entries.content: A "rut" is a period of 3-5 days where an Alpha will act more possessive, territorial and hormonal than normal in regards to their Omega. These periods occur in frequency after the start of the Omega-Alpha bonding process. This rut mirrors an Omega's heat.

entries.name: Scenting
entries.content: Alphas, Betas and Omegas have a very specific personal smell. A large part of their interactions depend on smell more than other senses. They have the ability to 'scent' others, rubbing their specific scent on another person or object, this is sometimes done as a mark of possession, intimacy or just trust. Omegas tend to have sweet and airy smells. Like peaches, cinnamon or honey for example. Alphas tend to have heavy and natural smells. Like forest-wood, seawater or black-tea for example. Betas tend to have no particular pattern in their smells.

entries.name: Slick
entries.content: Omegas -regardless of if female or male- present self-lubrication in their sexual organs when in intercourse, often referred to as 'slick', this slick increases in quantity if the Omega is in heat.

entries.name: Heat
entries.content: A "heat" is a period of 3-5 days where an Omega will experience heightened sexual excitability and have an increase in fertility. This period is also characterized by a large secretion of pheromones or 'scent'. A smell so strong it gets in the way of their daily lives. This heat mirrors an Alpha's rut.

entries.name: Suppressants
entries.content: Suppressants are medication given to Alphas or Omegas, specifically to suppress rut or heat cycles so they can continue their daily activities. It also suppresses the fertility of Omegas, serving as a form of Birth Control. Suppressants are available in either pill or injection form.

entries.name: Nesting
entries.content: During pregnancy or heat, Omegas will build 'nests' out of instinct, practically glorified pillow-fortresses, these are filled with various scents to comfort themselves, usually using scent candles, loved ones' clothes, pillows, blankets, etc.
